events.content:
`UserDashboard` is now an async server component that fetches user preferences on every request. The build passes, and the route output confirms the behavior: `/` is now marked `ƒ (Dynamic) — server-rendered on demand` instead of being statically prerendered.

What I did in `app/UserDashboard.tsx`:

- Added a `getUserPreferences()` helper that fetches `https://api.example.com/user/preferences` with `cache: 'no-store'`, which opts the fetch out of the data cache and makes the route dynamic so fresh user-specific data is fetched per request.
- Made the component `async` and awaited the data directly in it, following the same pattern as `getStaticData()` in `app/page.tsx`, including the try/catch with mock fallback data (`{ theme, language, notifications }`) so the build doesn't fail when the example API is unreachable.
- Rendered the preferences as a simple list (theme, language, notifications).

No changes were needed in `page.tsx` — it already renders `<UserDashboard />`, and async server components compose directly inside the existing async `Page`.
